name: AUTO-KHM-001 Japan Regulatory & Government News Digest - Error Handler (Draft - Not Deployed)

parameters.content:
## Error Handler for the Japan Reg News Digest workflow

This is a companion error-handling workflow. It does nothing on its own.

**Setup:**
1. Import this workflow.
2. Open the main digest workflow (AUTO-KHM-001_japan-reg-news-digest.json) and go to Settings > Error Workflow. Select this workflow.
3. From now on, if the main workflow fails at any node, n8n will automatically start this workflow and pass error details to the Error Trigger node below.
4. Set the Slack channel in the "Slack: Notify Admin (Error)" node to your own alerts channel, and register your own Slack credential.

Manual execution / test triggers will NOT invoke this workflow (Error Trigger only fires on n8n-detected failures).
